views.name: EMP_DETAILS_VIEW
views.text:
SELECT e.employee_id, e.job_id, e.manager_id, e.department_id, d.location_id, l.country_id,
       e.first_name, e.last_name, e.salary, e.commission_pct, d.department_name,
       j.job_title, l.city, l.state_province, c.country_name
  FROM employees e, departments d, jobs j, locations l, country_codes c
 WHERE e.department_id = d.department_id (+)
   AND d.location_id = l.location_id (+)
   AND l.country_id = c.country_id (+)
   AND j.job_id = e.job_id
  WITH READ ONLY

views.name: ORG_CHART
views.text:
SELECT LEVEL AS depth, employee_id, manager_id,
       LPAD(' ', 2 * (LEVEL - 1)) || last_name AS org_name,
       SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(last_name, '/') AS reporting_path
  FROM employees
 START WITH manager_id IS NULL
CONNECT BY PRIOR employee_id = manager_id
 ORDER SIBLINGS BY last_name

views.name: TOP_CUSTOMERS
views.text:
SELECT customer_id, cust_last_name, NVL(email, 'n/a') AS email, total_spend
  FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, c.cust_last_name, c.email, SUM(o.order_total) total_spend
          FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
         WHERE o.order_date >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -12)
         GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.cust_last_name, c.email)
 WHERE ROWNUM <= 100
 ORDER BY total_spend DESC

views.name: OPEN_ORDERS_V
views.text:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date,
       DECODE(o.order_status, 0, 'NEW', 1, 'PICKING', 2, 'SHIPPED', 'OTHER') AS status_text
  FROM orders o
 WHERE o.order_date > SYSDATE - 30
MINUS
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, 'SHIPPED'
  FROM orders o
 WHERE o.order_status = 2
